Remark
[Remark and warning] ↗ thm:schaefer-quasilinear-existence 1. ch9:9.2.2-rem-2\group Fixed Point Theorems

The iteration \[ \begin{cases} -\Delta u^{k+1} + \mu u^{k+1} = -b(Du^k) & \text{in } U \\ u^{k+1} = 0 & \text{on } \partial U \end{cases} \quad (k = 0, 1, \ldots ). \] is not guaranteed to converge to a solution of (21): Schauder's and Schaefer's theorems assert existence of fixed points, not convergence of iterates.
